transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’ve lost all interest in teaching and the activities I used to enjoy, and I can’t seem to care about anything the way I used to. I finally decided to seek help after my principal suggested I take a personal day because colleagues noticed I was missing deadlines and slipping.
Have you had any experiences like hearing voices, seeing things others don’t, or believing things that others say are not true?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I don't hear or see things that aren't there, and I don't have any beliefs that others find unusual. It's really just this heavy, flat feeling that I can't seem to shake.
How much has this low mood and loss of interest affected your ability to work, take care of yourself, and do everyday tasks? Have you had days when you could barely function at all?

It's had a massive impact, and I'm honestly embarrassed by how much I'm slipping. At work, I've started missing grading and documentation deadlines, which led to my principal having to check in on me. At home, I've stopped seeing friends, neglected basic chores, and let our finances get completely disorganized, which is causing a lot of tension with my husband.
How long have you been feeling this depressed and losing interest in things? Has it been present nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yes, it's been going on for much longer than two weeks—it has been present nearly every day for about a year and a half now. It really started building not long after I took on the extra STEM track and club responsibilities at school, and it just hasn't let up.
Have you had any thoughts that you are worthless, guilty in an extreme way, or that life is not worth living, or any thoughts of harming yourself?

Yes, I constantly feel like a terrible teacher and a bad wife who is letting everyone down, and I spiral into extreme guilt over every mistake. Sometimes at night, I do think it would be a relief if I just didn't wake up or got into an accident, though I don't have any plan to actually harm myself.

Have you had any thoughts that seem out of touch with reality, such as believing you are being punished for something, that you are responsible for terrible events, or that your body is seriously ill or changed in a way others would say is not true?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. While I do feel a lot of guilt and feel like a failure at work and home, I know these feelings aren't delusions or out of touch with reality. I've never believed I was being punished or that my body was physically altered in some impossible way.
Have you ever had a similar episode of depression or loss of interest before this one, or is this the first time it has happened?

No, I’ve never felt this way before. This is the very first time I’ve experienced anything like this in my life. I’ve always been the organized one who could handle everything, so this is completely new to me.
